text: The Allies needed Hitler to look somewhere else, and they knew where he was already looking. Hitler feared an attack in the Balkans. So the Allies built a wider deception, code-named Barclay, to feed that fear: a fictional Twelfth Army based in Cairo, dummy tanks in Syria, Greek interpreters recruited, Greek maps and currency stockpiled.
